scope: Existing full-depth pretrained ViT-B/16 numerical reconstruction experiment; no new model runs. Fully live attention and LayerNorm, three validation images, nine runs, no test-set evaluation or tuning.
model: pretrained torchvision ViT-B/16, 224x224, all twelve pre-normalization encoder blocks
gradient_correction_guard: Global shift_and_correct raises; _repair_reverse must return the identical incoming tuple.
forward_stabilization: Each numerical pair is reconstructed as scaled common value plus/minus half a cached independently replayed ordinary activation. Forward equality is deliberately maintained; reference gradients are not injected.
structural_scope: Input-dependent recentering and scaling do not establish global convexity of stabilized numerical streams. Exact real-arithmetic DC theorem remains separate.
